content.text: Yeruzalemu, ohogole omushangi gw’emishîbo n’oburhè, oyambale obukuze bw’irenge lya Nyamuzinda ensiku n’amango.
Ocîhundikire ecishûli c’obushinganyanya bwarhenga emwa Nyamuzinda, ohire n’ishungwè ly’irenge lya Nyamubâho w’ensiku n’amango oku irhwe lyâwe.
Bulya Nyamuzinda ayêrekana obwinjà bwâwe omu igulu lyoshi linabà idako ly’amalunga,
anakuhè izîno oku nsiku zoshi, eryo izîno ly’eri

Yimuka, Yeruzalemu, oyimange ahalengerîre, olabe ebushoshôkero bw’izûba, lolà oku abâna bâwe bashûbûzibwe n’akanwa k’Omwîmâna kurhenga ebuzikiro bw’izûba kuhika emunda lishoshôka, erhi banashangalusire oku Nyamuzinda anakengîre.
Bàrhenzire omu mihango yâwe bàgenda n’amagulu, erhi baminisirwe n’abashombanyi, ci Nyamuzinda àkugalulîrebo, badwîrhwe omw’irenge nka kula bahêka entebe y’omwâmi.
Bulya Nyamuzinda ànarhegesire okuyofihya ngasi ntondo elihûsire, lyo igulu lyoshi liyumânana, ntyo Israheli anahash’igenda kwinjà omu irenge lya Nyamuzinda.
Ciru n’emizirhu na ngasi murhi gwa bukù buhumula bwinjà, nayo yàrheganyîze Israheli ecihoho câyo, oku bulonza bwa Nyamuzinda.
Bulya Nyamuzinda âhêka Israheli n’obusîme, omu bulangashane bw’irenge lyâge, omu lukogo n’obushinganyanya bwârhenga emwâge.
